name: The Hand of Glory (Necromancy Rituals, Intermediate)

system.description: A mummified hand cut from a condemned murderer, cured with salt, saltpeter, and long peppers, then dried with vervain and fern. Once created (a static challenge, difficulty 7 Traits, retesting with Occult), anyone can activate it by coating its fingertips with fat from a hanged man, lighting them, and speaking the phrase, "Let all those who are asleep be asleep, and let those who are awake be awake." All mortals within the household affected fall into unrousable sleep for the scene; each unaffected occupant leaves one finger unlit. Only the creator can extinguish the hand at will; anyone else must use milk. The hand may be reused indefinitely. Has no effect on supernatural creatures or Hunters.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
